title: vl22: the multiplier in the canonical Lagrangian is inconsistent with the stationarity result
reason: An inconsistency of multiplier definitions, not a wrong sign in isolation: with f = -k tr(rho log rho) + beta tr(rho H) and normalisation, stationarity gives rho ~ exp(+beta H / k), whereas the lines that follow (vl22.tex:41-46) give exp(-beta H). The fix must define the multiplier: S - k beta (tr(rho H) - E) - k gamma (tr(rho) - 1), or else distinguish the arbitrary multiplier from the inverse temperature.

evidence.independent_check: docs/plan/research/review/REVIEW.md:60 (section B, row 'vl22 canonical Lagrangian': CONFIRMED as an inconsistency of multiplier definitions); PLAN.md section 13.2
evidence.notes: new_text is the review's first option written in the script's notation (k, \widehat{H}); the surrounding sentences (vl22.tex:26-41), which introduce beta, must be adapted with it. Which option is taken is TJO's choice.
